name: fxbg-palantir-city-manager
description: Real-time situational awareness dashboard for Fredericksburg, VA metro area

scripts.env:where: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const crypto=require('crypto');const f=p.join(__dirname,'.env');console.log('ENV_PATH=',f);if(fs.existsSync(f)){const s=fs.statSync(f);const c=fs.readFileSync(f);const h=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(c).digest('hex').slice(0,8);console.log('mtime=',s.mtime.toISOString(),'size=',s.size,'sha256='+h+'...');}else{console.log('MISSING');}"
